business_summary.text: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands is a fashion and lifestyle retailer (post-demerger from Aditya Birla Fashion) operating Lifestyle Brands such as Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly and Peter England plus Emerging Businesses Reebok, Van Heusen Innerwear and American Eagle, through 3,348 stores and e-commerce.

call_points.text: Gross margin fell about 150 bps YoY on channel mix and higher provisioning; management called it not material.
Marketing spend was about 3.5% of sales, lower YoY as the company moved from IPL to digital advertising.
Apparel is now 32-33% of Reebok, up from 26-27% at acquisition; women's wear remains small.
BIS approval for imported Reebok factories remains an annual renewal issue; the company is diversifying sourcing domestically.
Karnataka's minimum wage hike excludes garmenting, and manufacturing is about 40% of production, spread across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
Quick commerce is still a very small part of the business, led by innerwear.

guidance.statement: Capex of ₹250-300 Cr planned for FY27, about ₹200 Cr into retail expansion and renovation
Steady-state like-to-like growth projected at about 7%
Dividend of close to 15-25% of net profit indicated; debt-free aspiration in three years
Reebok network to add 40-50 stores per year for the next few years
Van Heusen Innerwear targeting at least one profitable quarter in FY27
Targeted expansion of more than 300 gross stores in FY27, 150-200 net
Small-town share of retail revenue to exceed 20% over the next three to four years
Reebok to grow at about 20% over the longer term and double revenue in three to three-and-a-half years
guidance.target: about 20% growth; double from about ₹500 Cr

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > Speciality Retail

operating_notes.text: Q4 'other' channel in Lifestyle Brands rose to about ₹120-130 Cr from a ₹65-70 Cr run rate, driven by contract manufacturing and institutional business.
COCO stores are about 36-37% of the network, roughly 1,200-1,250 stores.
Store closures run 3-5% of the network depending on brand; FY26 net additions were about 55-60 for Lifestyle Brands.
Retail is about 65% of the overall lifestyle portfolio; Emerging Brands has a slightly smaller retail share and larger wholesale and e-commerce, driven by Innerwear and Reebok.
Van Heusen Innerwear has about 38,000-40,000 trade outlets, with about 20% network addition expected over the next couple of years.
Reebok operates about 200 stores versus 500-700 for the other premium brands, which management cites as under-penetration.

timeline.summary: Q1FY27 earnings call (Aug 3, 2026): revenue ₹2,046 Cr, up 11% YoY; EBITDA ₹327 Cr, margin 16%; PAT ₹29 Cr, up 21%; 68 gross stores added, network at 3,362.
